title: funastrum pannosum
intro: Funastrum pannosum, commonly known as Devil's Claw, is a climbing plant native to the Americas. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include pain relief, reducing inflammation, and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Funastrum pannosum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating conditions such as arthritis and other musculoskeletal disorders. The bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoid glycosides, specifically harpagoside, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
